The TSDoc must declare the three behaviours above and name the refusal (ADR-0112 envelope, the window and the claim) so the services implementer on #14501 codes against the contract text, not against this card.

推荐意见必须基于这四条轴给出理由;四轴冲突时如实呈现权衡,
